item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Call for Applications Based on Qualifications and Interview for the Award of 1 “Research Contract,” pursuant to Article 22 of Law No. 240 of December 30, 2010—at the Interdepartmental Center for Ethics and Integrity in Research (Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 18:00
Institution: Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche, Roma
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-05 Sociologia generale

The Research Fellow will be assigned to conduct study and research activities in the following areas: ethics and integrity in research, methodologies and applications in the social sciences and in the cognitive and behavioral sciences. The Research Fellow will also be involved in the activities of the CNR’s Commission for Ethics and Integrity in Research, particularly in the process of issuing ethical clearance opinions for projects to be carried out at the Agency, and in the examination of cases of alleged research misconduct
